---
type: parens
title: 'Make $2 \cdot x + 3$ equal $2x + 6$'
expression: 2 · x + 3
target: 2 · x + 6
---

Tap a gap to place **(**, then a gap to its right to place **)**. Put one pair of parentheses in so that it equals $2x + 6$ for every $x$.

## Hint
$6 = 2 \cdot 3$. The $2$ has to multiply the $3$ as well as the $x$.

## Solution
**Answer:** $2 \cdot (x + 3)$

The $2$ multiplies everything in the parentheses: $2 \cdot (x + 3) = 2x + 2 \cdot 3 = 2x + 6$.
